messages:
maria: Quick Q — I'm kicking off the Q2 recurring incident patterns review. I've pulled the last 6 months of incidents and summarized top recurring root causes: autoscaler thrashing, cache-stampedes on cold deploy, DB failover storms, and model OOMs for long-context requests. Sharing doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/q2-patterns-1750001234 :eyes: I'll paste a short TL;DR and propose owners for each theme.
sam: Nice — can we prioritize fixes that reduce customer-visible SLO breaches? Suggest starting with autoscaler and DB failover.
natalie: Agreed. On autoscaler: INC-4342 and INC-4460 show the same pattern — aggressive target chasing when short batch jobs spike CPU. Proposed mitigations: add cooldown window, use CPU+queue-length signals, and a canary scaling policy. Owner: @sam. ETA: 2025-03-01.
lee: For model OOMs the common cause was long-context chat sessions combined with quantized kernel edge cases. Short-term: cap seq_len for hosted tier to 8k and add a warning response when users exceed threshold. Owner: @lee. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/1234. ETA: 2025-02-10.
oncall-bot: incident-summary pulled for period 2024-09-01..2025-02-28: total incidents: 72, repeat incidents (same root cause within 30d): 18, top categories by count: autoscaler (22%), db-failover (19%), cache-stampede (14%), model-oom (11%).
sam: Can we add a Console dashboard tile for "repeat incidents by root cause" with a 90-day rolling window? Ops SRE to own. @natalie can you mock a wireframe for the tile?
natalie: Yep, adding task ASANA-998. I'll sketch a mock and drop it in the doc by EOD Friday.
maria: Short action list (so it's explicit):
  1) Autoscaler cooldown + multi-signal scale rules — owner: sam — ETA: 2025-03-01
  2) DB failover smoothing + connection pooling hardening — owner: lee — ETA: 2025-03-15
  3) Cache prefix warming + KV TTL tuning — owner: natalie — ETA: 2025-02-28
  4) Model seq_len cap + alerting for long-context requests — owner: lee — ETA: 2025-02-10
  5) Runbook updates to flag repeat incidents + monthly audit task — owner: ops-scheduler — recurring
Please call out if any ETA looks unrealistic.
ops-scheduler: Scheduling a recurring retrospective. I'll ping this thread every month on the 1st and create a recurring calendar invite.
sam: I'll open the PR for autoscaler changes next week and add a perf job that simulates short CPU spikes + queue pressure. Will post perf links once green.
lee: DB fencing changes require a small migration/maintenance window. I'll propose a maintenance slot and add notes to the release calendar.
maria: Let's reconvene in two weeks for a status check. If anyone needs to reassign owner, say so now.
natalie: One additional observation — several cache-stampede incidents come from cold deploys where top prefixes aren't warmed. Ops: add a deploy hook to pre-warm the top-50 prefixes from the last 7 days of traffic. Owner: natalie. ETA: 2025-02-20.
sam: +1. Also propose a new metric: monthly % of incidents that are repeats (same root cause). Target: reduce by 50% QoQ.
maria: I'll add these AIs to the follow-up board and tag with "recurring-patterns.q2". Full doc again: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/q2-patterns-1750001234
lee: ack
natalie: :thumbsup:
sam: :rocket:
